description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Master Mode], [Master Mode: Quina], and [Instant ATB 1] to user. Grants [Learning Mode: Quina (IX)] and [Instant ATB 1] to all allies if the user has realm synergy, else grants [Learning Mode: Quina] and [200% ATB 1] to all allies

description.name: Master Mode: Quina
description.text: Casts [Star Strike: Quina] every 2s (max 5), casts [North Star: Pumpkin Bomber] after 15s, removed if user hasn't Master Mode

description.name: Star Strike: Quina
description.text: If the user has realm synergy, ten single ranged attacks (0.90 each), grants [Soul Break Gauge +50] to the user, and increases Learning Mode: Quina (IX) level by one for all allies. Otherwise, causes [Deprotect 10% (5s)] to target, grants [Stoneskin: 10%] to all allies with Learning Mode: Quina, and increases Learning Mode: Quina level by one for all allies

description.name: Soul Break Gauge +50
description.text: Grants 50 soul break points when set

description.name: Deprotect 10% (5s)
description.text: Increases physical damage taken by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Stoneskin: 10%
description.text: Reduces damage taken to 0, up to an amount equal to 10% of the character's maximum HP, removed when that amount is reached

description.name: Master Mode
description.text: Instant cast speed and no cost for the first Soul Break cast, grants [Hero Boost] and sets the Hero Boost level to 1 when set

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Learning Mode: Quina (IX)
description.text: Keeps track of Learning Mode: Quina (IX) level (0~5), Damage +5/10/15/20/25/30% at Learning Mode: Quina (IX) level 0/1/2/3/4/5

description.name: Learning Mode: Quina
description.text: Keeps track of Learning Mode: Quina level (0~5), Deadly Strikes 5/10/15/20%/25%/30% to the user Learning Mode: Quina level 0/1/2/3/4/5

description.name: 200% ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x2.00

description.name: North Star: Pumpkin Bomber
description.text: One single ranged attack (8.00 each) capped at 199999, grants [Deadly Strikes +30% 1] and [Instant Cast 1] to all allies

description.name: Deadly Strikes +30% 1
description.text: Critical hits deal 30% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient and other Critical Damage statuses)
